event_description: Flood emergency declared March 29, 2004 for 10 counties and the Spirit Lake Indian Reservation, upgraded to a disaster declaration on April 20 and widened to six more northern counties on June 9 (dated report of June 29, 2004).

Emergency declaration for the Northwood tornado of Sunday night, August 26, 2007 in Grand Forks County, issued Monday, August 27 with the National Guard sent to help with cleanup (AP report of August 28; Prairie Public, August 27).

Statewide flood emergency declared in anticipation of spring flooding, per the Governor's release of March 16, 2009, 'Hoeven Declares Statewide Flood Emergency' (the release is no longer online; Wikipedia's 2009 North Dakota floods article cites it).
Statewide emergency declared June 9, 2005 for the impacts of recent severe thunderstorm systems (dated report of June 14, 2005).
Snow emergency order activating all state resources for the January 2010 winter storms, issued by January 26, 2010 (dated report of that day; exact signing date not given).

Flood emergency declaration issued March 30, 2006 for the riverine and overland flooding along the Red River of the North and its tributaries from rapid snowmelt and rain (FEMA National Situation Update, April 1, 2006).

Snow emergency declared for the southeast part of the state after the late November 2005 blizzard, to get federal help to fix damage (AP report of November 30, 2005; the signing day is not given, so the row carries the date of the report).
